items.title: 5.2 Mechanical properties of solids (solids ki mechanical khoobiyan) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.2 with Figs. 5.1 and 5.2 (PDF 95).

blocks.text: Agar hum naram rubber ki gend haath mein le kar dabayein to gend ki shakal ya volume badal jata hai. Dabana chhor kar haath kholein to gend wapas apni asal gol shakal mein aa jati hai. Fig. 5.1 yahi dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Teen grey rubber ki gendein qatar mein. (a) Asal gend. (b) Aath magenta teer, har ek par F, har taraf se andar dabate hain aur gend chhoti ho jati hai. (c) Force hatane ke baad gend wapas (a) jitni ho jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.1: (a) Asal rubber ki gend (b) Haath ki force F se dabi hui gend (c) Force hatane ke baad gend (kitab ki Figure 5.1 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Isi tarah rubber ki dori ke dono sire haathon mein pakar kar haath thore door karein to haathon ki force se dori ki lambai barh jati hai. Force jitni zyada, lambai mein increase utna zyada. Force hatayein to dori wapas apni asal lambai par aa jati hai. In misalon se pata chalta hai ke jab kisi object par bahar se force lage to deformation (shakal, lambai ya volume mein change) paida hoti hai.

Crystalline solids mein atoms aam taur par ek khaas tarteeb mein hote hain. Har atom apni equilibrium position (balance wali jagah) ke gird rehta hai; yeh jagah atoms ke beech inter-atomic cohesive force (atoms ko jor kar rakhne wali force) ki taqat par depend karti hai. Bahar se force lagne par atoms apni equilibrium position se hil jate hain, is liye object mein distortion (shakal ka bigarna) aata hai, aur kehte hain ke object stress ki halat mein hai. Force hatane par atoms wapas apni equilibrium position par aa jate hain aur object apni asal shakal dobara pa leta hai, shart yeh hai ke force bohat zyada na ho. Object ki apni asal shakal mein wapas aane ki ability ko elasticity kehte hain. Fig. 5.2 dikhati hai ke bahar ki force se crystal ke ek unit cell (crystal ka sab se chhota hissa jo baar baar dohraya jata hai) mein kya deformation hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch atoms wale unit cell ke chaar drawings: har kone par ek aur beech mein ek, chhoote hue daire. (a) Bina khinchav: gol atoms. (b) Bahar ki taraf khenchne wali force: atoms lambe oval (ande jaisa lamba gol) aur cell ooncha. (c) Andar ki taraf force: atoms chapte elliptical (ande jaisa lamba gol) aur cell neecha aur chaura. (d) Force hatane ke baad: bilkul (a) jaisa.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.2: (a) Bina khinche unit cell (b) Bahar khenchti force lagne par (c) Andar ki force lagne par (d) Force hatane ke baad (kitab ki Figure 5.2 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Atoms ke beech cohesive force unhen equilibrium ki jagah par rakhti hai. Bahar ki taraf kheenchein to cell lamba ho jata hai (b), andar dabayein to chapta (c). Force hatate hi yahi andar ki force atoms ko wapas le aati hai (d): isi ko elasticity kehte hain.

blocks.caption: Deformation ki misalein
rows: atoms equilibrium se hat jate hain (stress ki halat)
atoms wapas aa jate hain, agar force bohat zyada na thi

blocks.prompt: Rubber ki dori kheench kar chhorne par woh wapas apni lambai par kyun aati hai? Agar force bohat zyada ho to kya ho sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Force se atoms apni equilibrium position se hat jate hain; force hatane par atoms ke beech cohesive force unhen wapas kheench leti hai, is liye dori asal lambai par aa jati hai (elasticity). Kitab kehti hai ke yeh tab hota hai jab force bohat zyada na ho; bohat zyada force se object apni asal shakal wapas nahi pata (is ki detail 5.5 mein elastic limit ke saath hai).

items: Bahar ki force se deformation hoti hai: shakal, lambai ya volume badalta hai.
Force se atoms equilibrium se hat jate hain (stress ki halat); force hatane par wapas aate hain, agar force bohat zyada na thi.
Asal shakal mein wapas aane ki ability = elasticity.
